learning.analyze.tip: Analyze your learning with AI: it organizes, groups into paths and suggests what to learn (uses tokens)
learning.intro: 🎓 Topics you are learning/reinforcing. Group them into paths, tap "🎓 Explain this" for a review that reads the real code, and use "Analyze" to have the AI organize everything and suggest what to study.
learning.routes.title: 🗺️ Learning paths
learning.routes.empty: No paths yet. Group related topics into a study path (or let "Analyze" suggest one).
learning.grid.empty: You haven't added any topics yet. Use "New topic" to start (e.g. "How GetPad works", "How to propose a fix in a PR").
learning.form.question: Specific question (optional)
learning.form.questionPh: What exactly you want to understand
learning.form.notesPh: Chris's instructions, prior details, what you already know… (supports Markdown)
learning.routeForm.title: Path title
learning.detail.title: 🎓 Topic
learning.guide.empty: You haven't generated this topic's guide yet. "Regenerate" analyzes EVERYTHING in one pass — real code + your notes + the additional context — and builds the full guide.
learning.sections.emptyGuide: Sections appear when you generate the guide — they're the pieces that make it up.
learning.sections.noSeparable: The guide has no separable sections (regenerate it so they're built).
learning.versions.title: 🕑 Previous versions ({n})
learning.check.fresh: 🟢 Up to date — no changes to notes, context or code since last time.
learning.check.stale: 🟡 There are changes ({why}) — "Regenerate" will ADAPT the guide, not start from scratch.
learning.explain.adminNote: Ask an admin to generate the guide (uses tokens).
learning.cx.empty: No additional context yet. Add a manual note, paste a transcript, or open "💬 Deep-dive in chat" (when you close it, its summary comes back here) — everything is incorporated into the next guide.
learning.notes.title: 📝 Notes / context
learning.notes.empty: No notes. Tap ✏️ to write what you already know, Chris's instructions, etc.
learning.cx.title: 🎙️ Additional context
learning.error.title: Error
learning.delTopic.title: Delete topic
learning.delTopic.msg: Delete "{title}"? Its guided explanation is also lost. This can't be undone.
learning.regen.forceMsg: You're about to REGENERATE the explanation of "{title}" from SCRATCH (ignores what it had). Uses tokens and may take 1-2 min.
learning.regen.adaptMsg: The AI checks for changes (notes, additional context or cited code) since last time and {verb} the explanation of "{title}" — it only uses tokens if needed.
learning.regen.title: 🎓 Regenerate explanation
learning.regen.noopFallback: No changes, no need to regenerate.
learning.addNote.title: ✍️ Add note
learning.addNote.hint: Context note for this topic (added to the list and included in the next explanation). Supports Markdown.
learning.editEntry.title: ✏️ Edit entry
learning.delEntry.title: Delete entry
learning.delEntry.msg: Delete this context entry? This can't be undone.
learning.cx.confirmMsg: Runs an AI interpretation (uses tokens) and is ADDED as an additional-context entry of the topic. Continue?
learning.poll.adapt: Adapting the explanation with the new changes…
learning.poll.full: Generating the full explanation (navigates the real code)…
learning.analysis.confirmMsg: The AI will review ALL your topics and suggest how to organize them: duplicates, merge, complete, group into paths, what to learn first and new topics. Uses tokens. Proposals aren't applied automatically: you approve each one.
learning.analysis.empty: The AI found nothing to reorganize. Your bank is already tidy. 🎉
learning.delRoute.title: Delete path
learning.delRoute.msg: Delete the path "{title}"? Its topics stay WITHOUT a path (they aren't deleted).
